input.content: Retry path skips re-applying or freezes the first attempt's payload. When the contract says a failed operation can be retried with edited values and success means the latest values are active, the retry must apply the new payload. It cannot gate apply on status == "pending" or reuse values stored on the first attempt. This matters especially when the failure happens after apply, such as a receipt write failing, which leaves status "applied". If the provider is idempotent, re-apply on every non-completed attempt. (service.save review 2026-10-11)
